mechanism.claim: In a volatile completed BTC block, leveraged inventory accumulation or liquidation has different continuation odds depending on OI path efficiency, OI terminal location and perpetual premium dislocation; one fixed pre-2023 ridge estimates that state-dependent next-eight-hour direction.
mechanism.side: strict sign of frozen ridge prediction
mechanism.why_distinct: HVLPSR is an eight-hour multivariate inventory-and-premium state model. It does not use the prior OI lead correlation, purge rule, their event sets, their diagnostic controls, or any opened economic outcome; common comparison gates remain unchanged.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: continuous OI-path and premium-state prediction is absent from Gross9

training_contract.label: log(exit_open/entry_open), entry=D+5m, exit=entry+8h; exit strictly before label-window end
training_contract.training_rows: all source-valid rows with finite ordered features and complete labels
training_contract.standardization: population mean/std on training rows only; reject nonfinite or zero scale
training_contract.estimator: closed-form standardized ridge with intercept alpha=100
training_contract.prediction_strength_threshold: numpy linear-method q75 of absolute fitted predictions among training rows variation_rank>=0.65; OOS uses >=

feature_contract.price: 480 exact coherent bars_binance 1m rows [D-8h,D); 96 exact aggregated 5m log(close/open) returns
feature_contract.premium: 480 exact finite coherent bars_binance_premium 1m rows [D-8h,D); signed close values only
feature_contract.open_interest: 97 exact unique positive open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m source=open_interest_hist rows [D-8h-5m,D), yielding 96 log changes
feature_contract.normalized_returns: full and final-two-hour price returns divided by sqrt(sum 96 squared 5m returns)
feature_contract.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over <=270 valid blocks, minimum180, current excluded
feature_contract.oi_features: full/last24-change log sums; abs(full)/sum(abs changes); sqrt(sum squared changes); 2*(last-min)/(max-min)-1
feature_contract.premium_features: full mean, final-two-hour mean, terminal close, terminal-minus-first close, max-minus-min
feature_contract.source_validity: exact timestamps, no duplicates/imputation, finite positive coherent price OHLC, finite signed coherent premium OHLC, positive OI, all denominators positive

oos_clock.eligibility: source valid, variation_rank>=0.65, frozen prediction finite/nonzero, abs prediction>=frozen q75
oos_clock.reservation: fixed boundaries half-open; exit first on equal open
oos_clock.funding: not input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable-then-adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: new continuous leverage-premium state model specified before its labels or candidate incidence

stopping_rule: freeze prereg, model, source support, novelty, economics; terminal first failure; no feature/alpha/threshold/side/hold/clock/subset/control repair
